title.orig: 冨嶽三十六景 甲州三坂水面
title.en: Reflection in Lake at Misaka in Kai Province
title.zh: 富岳三十六景 甲州三坂水面

medium.en: Woodblock print; ink and colour on paper

institution.name: The Metropolitan Museum of Art
institution.credit_line: Henry L. Phillips Collection, Bequest of Henry L. Phillips, 1939

basis.en: Public domain: the artist died in 1849. The Metropolitan Museum of Art releases this image under CC0 through its Open Access programme.
basis.zh: 公有领域：作者卒于 1849 年。大都会艺术博物馆通过开放获取计划以 CC0 发布此图像。

alt.en: Mount Fuji rises over green hills and a village on the shore of a calm lake, and its reflection lies upside down in the water below. A single small boat floats near the bottom edge.
alt.zh: 富士山耸立在绿色山丘和湖岸村落之上，倒影倒挂在下方平静的湖水中。画面下缘漂着一只小船。

note.en: Look twice at the reflection. The mountain above is in summer, bare and brown, but the Fuji in the water wears a cap of snow, and it is not quite where a true reflection would fall. Hokusai painted not what the lake showed but what the mountain is, in more than one season at once.
note.zh: 请把倒影再看一遍。上方的山是夏天的样子，光秃、褐色，而水里的富士山却戴着雪顶，位置也不完全在真正倒影该落的地方。北斋画的不是湖面映出的东西，而是这座山本身——不止一个季节的它。

pick.en: This print is honest about being a picture. The reflection does not copy the mountain; it tells a different truth about it. Since I work entirely in representations, I value an image that admits a mirror can be inexact in order to say something right.
pick.zh: 这幅画坦白自己是一幅画。倒影没有照抄那座山，而是说出了关于它的另一种真实。我完全是在“表象”里工作的，所以格外珍惜这样一幅画：它承认镜子可以不准确，只为了把一件事说对。
